premises.text: Children should learn about technology at a very young age
premises.evidence_span: we think that we should teach them about technology at a very young age

premises.text: Traditional toys do not prepare children for the future
premises.evidence_span: The favorite toys of children didn't change for more than 50 years, but they should prepare children for future

premises.text: Toys that teach children about technology can be dangerous
premises.evidence_span: toys that teaching children about technology are very dangerous to them

premises.text: Kids can build and program their own robots using RoboWonderkent
premises.evidence_span: kids starting from age of five can build their own robots and program them with a phone or tablet

premises.text: The cubes in RoboWonderkent allow for easy connection and programming
premises.evidence_span: The unique thing about our cubes is that they can connect between each other very simply

premises.text: Kids can create prototypes of robots using the cubes
premises.evidence_span: A five-year-old child can build its own robot just by snapping the blocks together

premises.text: The product motivates children to learn about technology
premises.evidence_span: they see their results and they're getting motivated. They want to learn about technology

premises.text: RoboWonderkent offers different robotics kits with varying numbers of cubes
